question: In the year 2021, the Indian men’s hockey team defeated which country to win the bronze medal in Tokyo Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Germany.**__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points:__**

__
 
• **On August 5, 2021, **Indian hockey's status was altered.
 
• The Indian men's hockey team **returned **to the **Olympic podium **for the first time in** 41 long years **at **Tokyo 2020**, taking home a **bronze medal **after **defeating Germany **in the third-place playoff.
 
• The **medal's importance **couldn't be emphasized enough.
 
• Indian hockey's decline over the following 40 years was puzzling as they dominated international hockey from the **1920s **through the **1980s**, a time during which they won **eight gold, one silver, **and **two bronze medals **at the **Olympics**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• India finally succeeded to break the Olympic hoodoo by reaching the **quarterfinals **in **Rio 2016 **after failing to go past the group rounds from 1984 to 2012.
 
• Progress at **Tokyo 2020** was essential to maintaining the momentum.
 
• The enigmatic** Manpreet Singh **served as **captain **of the Indian squad, which entered the Tokyo Olympics in consistent form under the direction of **coach Graham Reid.**
 
• The team's confidence before the Tokyo Olympics was boosted by winning medals at prestigious competitions as the **Asian Championships, Asia Cup, FIH Series Final,** and a **quarterfinal appearance **at the **FIH Men's World Cup 2018.**
